llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed PR-review memory tool, but it can automatically persist and resurface untrusted PR discussion content without clear trust-boundary safeguards.

dimensions.detail: Project-level PR review memory is proportionate to the stated purpose, but automatic capture and indexing can include contributor-controlled review content.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The inspected package is Markdown-only and does not ship executable scripts, dependency installs, remote payload retrieval, or privileged setup commands.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The workflow stores finding descriptions, suggested fixes, and extracted PR discussion context, then proactively surfaces entries later, but does not define sanitization, provenance trust levels, approval gates, or instruction/data boundaries for untrusted contributor text.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The artifacts explicitly describe automatic capture after PR review, permanent retention for high-scoring entries, search indexing, backlinks, and proactive surfacing in future work contexts.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The purpose is coherent: capture, organize, search, and resurface PR-review findings as project memory.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable with PR review findings and discussion context being retained and resurfaced later. Use it with a workflow that treats captured PR text as quoted historical data, requires trusted review before permanent storage, records provenance, and provides deletion or reapproval for stale or poisoned entries.
llm.findings: [T02] expected: The memory capture behavior is central to the skill, not hidden or malicious; however, the artifact-backed combination of automatic persistence, permanent retention, and later surfacing of untrusted PR content lacks documented controls against prompt-injection-style memory poisoning, so the concern is accepted as a Review issue rather than treated as malicious.
